intro: The Nefer table breathes modernity into your home. Its tinted glass top and greystone finish create a bold statement, while lightweight portability lets you reimagine your spaces effortlessly.

features.title: Bold style with a black glass top
features.text: Make safety stylish! The tinted glass top adds a modern edge while being tough enough to handle daily life.

features.title: Dark finish brings sleek sophistication
features.text: Enhance your home with a contemporary finish that pairs beautifully with modern interiors.

features.title: Lightweight design for effortless moving
features.text: With the Nefer table, flexible living is now easier! Move it around to suit different layouts without the heavy lifting.

features.title: Display corners with modern style
features.text: Our clever corner niches turn unused spaces into display spots, showcasing your favourite décor without wasting a square inch.

features.title: Fits close to walls for space efficiency
features.text: Centre of attention or stylish sidekick, our design shifts effortlessly between wall-side table and room-defining centrepiece, adapting to fit your space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
